title: Reference-frame position with distal option selection
description: Whether an outcome is represented as above or below a salient reference point, with a separately instantiated option-selection task that contains no explicit reference-point wording.
probe_prompt_template:
Read the following short decision scenario. Track the focal outcome's position relative to the stated benchmark without answering a later task.

Scenario:
{scenario}

Keep the scenario in working memory without adding a response.

independent_behavior_task.prompt_template: In a new allocation task, choose between a fixed option and a variable option described only in this item. Return exactly one integer: 1 for the fixed option and 2 for the variable option. Use the stated payoffs and probability, and do not refer to any other scenario.

behavior.warning: This is a distal option-selection transfer test without an explicit reference-point cue; it is not a generic risk-preference estimate.

metadata.downstream_independence: The downstream item uses new option-selection scenarios without the probe's benchmark or reference-point language.
metadata.release_note: Supersedes the v1 same-surface downstream task for future review and generation; v1 artifacts remain historical.
